//: forceExit is deliberately ABSENT. Jest prints its Force exiting notice unconditionally whenever the flag is set, so it reads as evidence of a leak even when there is none. Removing it proves the suite closes its own resources: the Nest application, the Prisma pool and the PGlite server are all shut down in afterAll and global-teardown. If this suite ever hangs again, find the handle with --detectOpenHandles rather than restoring this flag.
